data.title: Make done command more explicit with subcommands
data.body:
## Goal

Break down the `docket done` command into more explicit operations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket done ID` just marks bug as Done (minimal)
- [ ] `docket done ID --describe` also generates commit message
- [ ] `docket done ID --squash` squashes workspace commits
- [ ] `docket done ID --submit` creates PR (requires GitHub integration)
- [ ] Document the full workflow in help text
- [ ] Consider: `docket submit ID` as separate command

## Context

Current `docket done` does multiple things magically:
1. Transitions status to Done
2. Detects/switches workspace
3. Generates commit message via Claude
4. Updates jj commit

This is convenient but opaque. More explicit flags would give users control. Could also split into separate commands: `docket done`, `docket describe`, `docket submit`.

Lower priority: current behavior works well for the common case.

## Log
